_note: Spatial calibration for the 1632x1224 mode (run2-run10). Sub-pixel grid-line centers (half-max midpoints) on a median-collapsed ruler profile. Two ADJACENT vertical grid lines (flat plateau between them -> a single 100 um pitch, not 200) at x ~= 355 and x ~= 1048 -> period 695.35 px = 100 um. The y-axis had only one horizontal line in the FOV (1224 px < 2 periods) so it cannot give a period. Value matches the earlier hand measurement (0.1439) to 0.06%, CONFIRMING the length scale; since k_B ~ (um_per_px)^3, calibration contributes <1% to k_B and is NOT the source of the 19% high k_B. Uncertainty ~0.2% from sub-pixel center location over a single 695 px period.
applies_to: run2..run10 (1632x1224 mode only; NOT run1/test at 2560x1920)
method: sub-pixel half-max line centers + linear period fit (x-axis; y had <2 lines)
